title: Navy Combat Search and Rescue Train to Save Downed Pilot
description: Two U.S. Navy Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron 25, crews rescue a simulated downed pilot during a combat search and rescue exercise over the Pacific Ocean for COPE North 2019, on Mar. 4, 2019. CN19 is a long-standing exercise designed to enhance multilateral air operations among partner nations and will include humanitarian assistance and disaster relief airlift operations as well as large-force employment. Approximately 2,000 U.S. Airmen, Marines, and Sailors will exercise alongside approximately 800 RAAF and JASDF members during the exercise. (US Air Force video by Master Sgt. Alexander Farver)
keywords: HSC, multi-lateral, Cope North 19, helicopter, navy, exercise, rescue, USPACOM, CSAR
